title: Timesheet Maker
description: Build a weekly timesheet: enter start/end times per day, get daily hours, weekly total, and regular vs overtime split at 40 hours.
howto: Enter start and end times for each day (24-hour format); leave a day blank for a day off.
Press Calculate for daily hours and the weekly total.
Read the regular/overtime split — hours beyond 40 count as overtime.
Copy the summary for payroll or your records.

faqs.a: The standard 40-hour week: the first 40 hours are regular, anything beyond is overtime. Daily hours are start-to-end minus any unpaid break you enter.

faqs.q: Can I enter an unpaid break?
faqs.a: Yes — the break column subtracts unpaid minutes (e.g. a 30-minute lunch) from each day's hours.
If the end time is earlier than the start time, the tool assumes the shift ran past midnight and adds 24 hours.
